entries.jp: 他の仲間のところにも行ってみたらどうだ？
entries.en: Why not go and see some of our other companions?

entries.jp: 私のところへ来ていただけるのは{n}うれしいのですが、{n}他の仲間への気遣いもお忘れなきよう‥‥。
entries.en: I am glad you have come to see me, but please{n}remember to spare a thought for our{n}other companions...

entries.jp: ふっ、お前たちと共に休暇を{n}過ごすことになるとはな‥‥。
entries.en: Heh. To think I would end up spending my leave with all{n}of you...

entries.jp: いい天気だな。{n}こんな日は外にいるだけで体が休まる。
entries.en: Fine weather today. Just being outdoors on a day like{n}this does the body good.

entries.jp: 剣でもなんでも、{n}心に余裕がないとダメだな。
entries.en: Swordsmanship, or anything else, suffers if your mind{n}is not at ease.

entries.jp: マイ＝ロード‥‥。{n}共に休暇を過ごす幸せ、噛みしめております。
entries.en: My Lord... I am savoring the happiness of spending my{n}leave with you.

entries.jp: 良いお日和です。{n}こんな日は外にいるだけで心が休まります。
entries.en: What a lovely day. Simply being outdoors in weather like{n}this puts the heart at ease.

entries.jp: 差し出がましいようですが、{n}休暇の時は身体だけでなく、心もお休め下さい。
entries.en: I hope I am not overstepping, but please rest your{n}mind as well as your body during your leave.
